task: Literature-validated FLEXIBLE force field for ZIF-8 (Zn + 2-methylimidazolate), complete parameter set with provenance
note_on_directory: provenance_structure.json and zif8_*.cif files in this directory were written by a parallel structure-retrieval task, not by this force-field task.

anchor_paper.title: In-Depth Thermodynamic and Kinetic Analysis of Ethane Diffusion in ZIF-8
anchor_paper.authors: Bernd Schmidt, Pieter Cnudde, Veronique Van Speybroeck, Louis Vanduyfhuys (Ghent University CMM)
anchor_paper.force_field_used: Krokidas et al. flexible ZIF-8 FF (main text ref 60 = J. Phys. Chem. C 2015, 119, 27028, doi 10.1021/acs.jpcc.5b08554; the paper's own SI cites the same FF via ref 1 = Krokidas et al. ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2018, 10, 39631, doi 10.1021/acsami.8b12605). Engine: YAFF coupled with LAMMPS, 2x2x2 supercell (2208 atoms), NVT/NPT, electrostatics+vdW truncated and switched at 12.0 A, 0.5 fs timestep.

files.contains: Ghent University biblio record: metadata, abstract, download links. Published-version PDF is UGent-only; accepted manuscript docx is open access.

Full main text incl. Table 1 (ethane barrier + D_self at 300 K, NVT/NPT, Krokidas FF vs DFT vs Verploegh vs experiment), Table 2 (temperature dependence 250-400 K), Table 3 (loading dependence). Methods section documents the FF choice and MD settings.
files.ff_parameters: none reproduced (FF used by citation only)
files.completeness: n/a for parameters; PRIMARY source for anchor-paper physical numbers

files.url: derived locally from jpcc2024_ethane_zif8_accepted_manuscript.docx (w:t nodes of word/document.xml, Zotero field codes stripped)
files.contains: Machine-extracted plain text + the three tables. NOT a downloaded source; superscripts/equations lossy - defer to the docx for load-bearing values.

S1 hopping/random-walk model details, S2 FF-vs-DFT validation (SI-Table S1: TS-location sensitivity of barrier/diffusivity), S3-S5 deprojection/temperature/loading figures. Its ref 1 for the 'Krokidas et al. FF' is the 2018 ZIF-7-8 paper (10.1021/acsami.8b12605).
files.ff_parameters: none (no parameter tables; validation and analysis only)

files.publication: Krokidas, Moncho, Brothers, Castier, Jeong, Economou, 'On the Efficient Separation of Gas Mixtures with the Mixed-Linker Zeolitic-Imidazolate Framework-7-8', ACS Appl. Mater. Interfaces 2018, 10, 39631, doi 10.1021/acsami.8b12605
files.contains: PRIMARY, COMPLETE ZIF-8 flexible FF from the Krokidas group (the FF the 2024 anchor paper's SI cites). Figure S1 atom-type definitions (Zn, N, C1 ring CH, C2 N-C-N carbon, C3 methyl, H1 ring H, H2 methyl H). Table S1 (page S-2): 7 bond types (l0 in Angstrom, kl in kJ/mol/nm^2) and 11 angle types (theta0 in degrees, ktheta in kJ/mol/rad^2). Table S2 (page S-3): 6 torsion types (phi0 in degrees, multiplicity m, kphi in kJ/mol, source AMBER). Table S3 (page S-3): partial charges (e) and Lennard-Jones epsilon/sigma for all 7 atom types (sigma in nm; epsilon column header misprinted 'kJ/mol/nm2', values are kJ/mol AMBER-style). Also ZIF-7-8 FF (Tables S4-S6).
files.ff_parameters: atom types YES, partial charges YES, LJ YES, bonds YES, angles YES, dihedrals YES, impropers: NONE DEFINED (this FF has no improper terms for ZIF-8)
files.completeness: COMPLETE for ZIF-8 (given 'no impropers' is the FF design). Functional-form equations are not written out in the SI; conventions are pinned by the GROMACS implementation (zif8_gromacs_aanik_atomtypes_ZIF-8_Krokidas.itp: harmonic bond/angle GROMACS func 1, periodic proper dihedral func 1, Lorentz-Berthelot, fudgeLJ 0.5 / fudgeQQ 0.8333) whose numbers match these tables verbatim.

files.contains: COMPLETE parameter sets WITH EXPLICIT FUNCTIONAL-FORM EQUATIONS for FIVE flexible ZIF-8 force fields: FF1 = Zheng et al. 2012 (10.1021/jp209463a), FF2 = J. Jiang et al. 2012, FF3 = L. Zhang et al. 2013, FF4 = X. Wu et al. 2014 (10.1039/C4RA00664J), FF5 = Weng & Schmidt 2019. Table S1 non-bonded (epsilon kcal/mol, sigma Angstrom, q e), Table S2 bonds (Kr kcal/mol/A^2, r0 A), Table S3 angles (Ktheta kcal/mol/rad^2, theta0 deg), Table S4 Urey-Bradley (FF5), Table S5 impropers, Table S6 dihedrals (Kphi kcal/mol, phi0 deg), Table S7 Zn dihedrals, Table S8 cutoffs and 1-4 scaling, Table S9 RASPA-vs-LAMMPS energy validation. Krokidas FF is NOT among the five.

files.publication: Machine-readable GROMACS implementation of Krokidas et al. 2015 (10.1021/acs.jpcc.5b08554), adapted by A.V. Anikeenko for Sheveleva et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 2017, 121, 19880, doi 10.1021/acs.jpcc.7b06884
files.contains: [atomtypes] with mass/charge/sigma(nm)/epsilon(kJ/mol) + #define'd bond (func 1: b0 nm, kb kJ/mol/nm^2), angle (func 1: deg, kJ/mol/rad^2), proper dihedral (func 1: periodic) and improper (func 2, all zero) types. Header documents deviations from the paper: Zn charge 1.3426 vs published 1.3429 (system neutrality); atoms renamed to Zheng 2012 convention (paper C2->file C1 etc.); C2-C2-N angle 108.7 (author-provided topology) vs 107.9 (published); several unlisted dihedrals added from author-provided topology. Required [defaults]: comb-rule 2 (Lorentz-Berthelot), fudgeLJ 0.5, fudgeQQ 0.8333.
